in_marathi.name: Joydip
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Delight or Joy in the dip of the river
in_marathi.long_meaning: Joydip हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name 'Joydip' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'joya' meaning delight or joy and 'dip' meaning dip or immerse. This name is believed to signify the joy one feels when immersed in the river or in the company of loved ones.
